label: SmartParking_Backend_Core
info: Smart-Parking Backend Core: parking sessions, payment, RFID release, event logging, REST API, and MQTT commands for entry/exit barriers and displays. Parking occupancy, floor lighting, and DB maintenance are intentionally handled by separate flows. SQLite schema is managed natively on the Raspberry Pi at /home/iot/database/parking.db.

name: Event Log / SQL Result Router
SQL spots
func: msg.sp={flow:'list'};msg.topic='SELECT id,floor,spot_number,occupied,last_updated FROM parking_spots ORDER BY floor,spot_number';return msg;

name: SQL free spots
func: msg.sp={flow:'list'};msg.topic='SELECT floor,COUNT(*) AS free_count FROM parking_spots WHERE occupied=0 GROUP BY floor ORDER BY floor';return msg;

name: SQL recent events
func: msg.sp={flow:'list'};msg.topic='SELECT id,timestamp,eventtype,source,message,parking_session_id FROM event_logs ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 50';return msg;

name: SQL current session
func:
function esc(v){return String(v==null?'':v).replace(/'/g,"''")}function body(p){if(typeof p==='string'){try{return JSON.parse(p)}catch(e){return{plate:p}}}return p||{}}function plate(v){return String(v==null?'':v).trim().toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g,'')}function logMsg(eventtype,source,message,sid){return{sp:{flow:'log'},topic:"INSERT INTO event_logs(eventtype,source,message,parking_session_id) VALUES('"+esc(eventtype)+"','"+esc(source||'node-red')+"','"+esc(message||'')+"',"+(sid==null?'NULL':Number(sid))+');'}}function mqttPayload(o){return JSON.stringify(o)}function price(entry){var mins=Math.max(1,Math.ceil((new Date()-new Date(entry))/60000));var due=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(mins/15)*0.5);return{minutes:mins,amount_due:Number(due.toFixed(2))}}
var p=plate(msg.req.params.plate);if(!p){msg.statusCode=400;msg.payload={error:'missing_plate'};return[null,msg]}msg.sp={flow:'session_current',plate:p};msg.topic="SELECT * FROM parking_sessions WHERE plate='"+esc(p)+"' AND exit_time IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1";return[msg,null];
